ms.report:
This report on Milestone 1 has already been documented and sent to catalyst.iohk.io through the monthly google doc report. The entire video covering each presentation of the three resource persons of the program held on 21st October 2023 has been uploaded already on YouTube and link sent to catalyst.iohk.io through the monthly report. 
 OUTPUTS: The pdf report document contains the number of participants as 75, the interested students who registered on Ideascale through our education was 19 and 12 students expressed interest in registering on Yoroi wallet. The students were encouraged to take part in the African and global town hall when the meetings are posted on telegram. In their situation as orphans, few of them had phones which did not have features on them but they have promised to take part and use a common laptop during meetings. 
The program held at Graceland Care Home was very successful because they had never heard any such education and knowledge so they appreciated it. In the long term, they would be active members of the Cardano ecosystem.
ACCEPTABLE CRITERIA: Education was done which is shown in the video uploaded on You Tube and link provided below. Awareness was created and those who registered as mentioned above have been encouraged to be part of the Africa Town Hall meetings. As to recording their names and sharing publicly is not allowed because the orphanages did not want us to record their names against their wish. We only offered education and created awareness and a few willing ones registered on their own through our guidance which I documented the number that did so. Hopefully, they will join the Town Hall meetings and be active members of the community.
EVIDENCE OF MILESTONE COMPLETION: The evidence is shown by my report and video uploaded on YouTube for your view. 

YouTube link: https://youtu.be/rOlJ5AjVqFQ?si=FcIUbnTqKN9h25rk
